events.title: Winter Jubilee Warm Up
events.blurb: Titletown kicks off winter next to Lambeau Field with free train rides, reindeer photos, Mrs. Claus storytime and the Winter Jubilee Light Show on Lambeau's west facade every 30 minutes from 6 to 9 p.m. Skating on Hy-Vee Plaza and Santa's Workshop cost extra.
events.blurbEs: Titletown arranca el invierno junto a Lambeau Field con paseos en tren gratis, fotos con renos, cuentos con Mrs. Claus y el Winter Jubilee Light Show en la fachada oeste de Lambeau cada 30 minutos de 6 a 9 p.m. El patinaje en Hy-Vee Plaza y Santa's Workshop se pagan aparte.

events.title: Green Bay Gamblers vs. USA Hockey NTDP
events.addr: 820 Armed Forces Dr, Green Bay, WI 54304
events.blurb: USHL junior hockey as the Gamblers host the U.S. National Team Development Program on Friday night and Saturday evening.
events.blurbEs: Hockey juvenil de la USHL: los Gamblers reciben al U.S. National Team Development Program el viernes por la noche y el sábado por la tarde.

events.title: Garden of Lights
events.blurb: The botanical garden's walk-through holiday light show opens for the season Thanksgiving weekend, 4:30 to 9 p.m. each night.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo de luces navideñas del jardín botánico abre su temporada el fin de semana de Acción de Gracias, de 4:30 a 9 p.m. cada noche.

events.title: A Frank's Christmas
events.addr: 117 S Washington St, Green Bay, WI
events.blurb: Let Me Be Frank Productions opens its 27th original Christmas show, packed with familiar holiday songs and local comedy.
events.blurbEs: Let Me Be Frank Productions estrena su 27.º espectáculo navideño original, lleno de canciones navideñas conocidas y humor local.

events.title: Christkindlmarket on Broadway
events.addr: Red Sculpture Park & E Hubbard St, Green Bay, WI
events.blurb: A German-style outdoor holiday market in the Broadway District with gifts, food and drink, plus bookable igloos and a wood-fired sauna.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño al aire libre de estilo alemán en el Broadway District, con regalos, comida y bebida, además de iglús y una sauna de leña con reserva.

events.title: Holiday Gift & Craft Show
events.addr: 840 Armed Forces Dr, Green Bay, WI 54304
events.blurb: Small Business Saturday shopping with vendors selling handmade and vintage goods: carvings, ceramics, jewelry, quilts, stained glass, candles and toys.
events.blurbEs: Compras del Small Business Saturday con vendedores de artículos hechos a mano y vintage: tallas, cerámica, joyería, edredones, vitrales, velas y juguetes.

events.title: Green Bay vs. North Dakota
events.blurb: Phoenix men's college basketball hosts the North Dakota Fighting Hawks on Sunday afternoon.
events.blurbEs: El baloncesto universitario masculino de los Phoenix recibe a los North Dakota Fighting Hawks el domingo por la tarde.
